# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Situation
ALL 30 trajectories in `./trajectories/` are pure INFRASTRUCTURE failures ("SPA deploy
failed: SPA intervention library not found"), reward 0.0 — the 10 tasks flagged as
uncontrollable infra noise (8,11,12,17,19,22,23,25,37,40). There is therefore NO
task-level learning signal in this iteration's traces, and the focus block itself says
"No actionable failures in focus — seek a robustness/generalization gain that does not
regress the solid tasks." The tool surface is the standard tau2-airline set: bare 1:1
wrappers of the frozen primitives with ZERO validation.

Strategy: ship a small set of BOUNDED in-body guards that enforce the exact airline
policy rules the environment API explicitly does NOT check (policy.md repeatedly says
"the API does not check this, so the agent must make sure the rules apply"). Each guard
fires ONLY on a genuine policy violation, so by construction it cannot change the action
on any correctly-handled (gold) task — the blast radius is the set of already-wrong
actions. Every rule is grounded in `bench_repo` tools.py + policy.md, and the
derived-value formula is empirically validated against all 2000 DB reservations.

## Ranked issue list
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| — | (no actionable trace clusters — all traces are infra noise) | — | — | — | robustness/generalization guards grounded in policy.md |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic-economy flight change (policy: "Basic economy flights cannot be modified"; API does not check) | in-body RULE guard | update_reservation_flights.py | fetch reservation; if cabin=='basic_economy' AND the new flight segment multiset (flight_number,date) differs from existing → raise actionable error. Cabin-only change (same segments) still allowed, per policy. | Fires only when a basic-econ reservation's segments change — a valid action never does; economy/business changes untouched. |
| Baggage removal (policy: "can add but not remove checked bags"; API does not check) | in-body RULE guard | update_reservation_baggages.py | if total_baggages < existing total → raise. | Fires only on a reduction; valid additions/keeps never trip it. |
| Wrong nonfree_baggages (derived value the mid model miscomputes) | in-body computation guard | update_reservation_baggages.py + book_reservation.py | recompute expected paid bags = max(0, total − free_allowance), free_allowance = table[membership][cabin]×#passengers; raise with the correct value if mismatch. | Verified against ALL 2000 DB reservations: 0 mismatches, so no gold-consistent booking trips it. |
| >5 passengers (policy: "at most five passengers"; API does not check) | in-body RULE guard | book_reservation.py | raise if len(passengers) > 5. | Fires only on an over-limit booking; ≤5 untouched. |
| Enriched schema/docs | sharpened docstrings | all three tools | added the derived-value formula, basic-econ rule, and certificate-not-allowed-for-flight-change note to the schema the model reads. | Additive knowledge only; no decision loosened. |

## Verify-the-fix (stubbed primitives + real DB data; 10/10 as expected)
- update_reservation_flights: basic-econ segments CHANGED → guard raises; basic-econ SAME segments (cabin-only) → NO fire; economy segments changed → NO fire.
- update_reservation_baggages: total<existing → raises; add-bags WRONG nonfree → raises; add-bags CORRECT nonfree → NO fire.
- book_reservation: wrong nonfree → raises; correct nonfree → NO fire; 6 passengers → raises; 5 passengers valid → NO fire.
- Formula check: `nonfree == max(0, total − free[membership][cabin]×pax)` holds for 2000/2000 DB reservations (0 mismatches) → derived-value guards have an empty false-positive set.

## Blast-radius class
All edits are BOUNDED in-body guards: each raises ONLY on the precise violating
condition. No global decision/permission/refusal rule was loosened or broadened. No new
tool added, none removed; each file keeps exactly one top-level function named after it;
`primitive_tools/` and `SKILL.md` untouched. No `_make_api_call` use. No task-specific
literals — every guard encodes a general policy predicate.

## Process & features used
- Serial (no subagents): the whole signal is "all traces are infra noise", diagnosed in
  one pass; grounding the guards in bench_repo + a DB-wide formula check was the real work.
- Prior iterations read: none exist (seed baseline only; LEDGER/RUNMAP empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The derived-nonfree_baggages formula and its DB-wide validation (2000/2000). Reuse it,
  don't re-derive.
- Guards enforce ONLY API-unchecked policy rules — do not duplicate rules the API already
  enforces (payment-in-profile, certificate-for-update, gift-card balance, passenger-count
  match are ALL enforced by the primitives already; adding guards for them is redundant).

## Deliberately skipped
- "Cabin cannot be changed if any flight already flown" — needs flight-status lookups and
  date reasoning; high false-positive risk without trace evidence. Skipped this iteration.
- The 10 infra-errored tasks — uncontrollable noise, per instructions; changed nothing on
  their account.
